WITH refunds_by_order AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
            * CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
              END
        ),
        0
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN refunds_by_order AS r
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH apparel_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) AS has_refund
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM order_items oi
          JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
          WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
            AND p.category = 'apparel'
      )
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(has_refund AS DOUBLE)) AS apparel_order_refund_share
FROM apparel_orders;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) AS electronics_order_refund_share
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal
